notes:
{割|わ}る is a versatile transitive verb with three main meanings: divide, break, and dilute.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {割|わ}れる (intransitive: to break, be divided)

MATH USAGE (Sense 1):
Pattern: AをBで{割|わ}る = divide A by B
- 10を2で{割|わ}る = 10 ÷ 2
- {割|わ}り{切|き}れる: divisible
- {割|わ}り{切|き}れない: not divisible (also: can't accept emotionally)

BREAKING (Sense 2):
- {卵|たまご}を{割|わ}る: to crack an egg
- {窓|まど}を{割|わ}る: to break a window
- お{皿|さら}を{割|わ}る: to break a plate

DILUTING (Sense 3):
Pattern: AをBで{割|わ}る = dilute A with B
- {焼酎|しょうちゅう}を{水|みず}で{割|わ}る: to dilute shochu with water
- {水割|みずわ}り: whiskey/shochu with water
- お{湯割|ゆわ}り: with hot water

OTHER MATH TERMS:
- {掛|か}ける: multiply
- {足|た}す: add
- {引|ひ}く: subtract
